sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, gp.price AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimLinkProductDetail lk ON lk.PimProductId = p.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute la ON la.PimAttributeId = lk.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile anon ON anon.PortalId = po.PortalId AND anon.IsDefaultAnonymousProfile = @anonymousProfile CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pl.PriceListId, pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice, COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList pl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice pr ON pr.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf ON plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plf.PortalProfileId = anon.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND (plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR plo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY CASE WHEN plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @profileListRank ELSE @storeListRank END, plf.Precedence, plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pr.PriceId) gp WHERE lk.PimParentProductId = @product AND la.AttributeCode = @linkCode AND p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND p.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId), @zero) >= @quantityUsed AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT rq.PimAddOnProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND gp.price > @minPrice AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, p.SKU
